title: No Pawn on h7
setup: Black has just retreated its knight to h7, and the bishop on c4 still guards the f7-square.
hint: Something other than a pawn is standing on h7 — ask what that changes about the squares beside it.
explanation:
## The Idea

A knight on g6 is normally eaten by the h-pawn. Here h7 holds a knight, which guards nothing next to it, so {{Ng6#}} is untouchable and g8, g7 and h7 are all filled by Black's own pieces. The usual smothering square, f7, is covered by the bishop on c4.
